summary: The proposal presents a clear research direction but suffers from several structural and formatting violations. Critical issues include exceeding the allowed page limit and insufficient detail in objective subsections, while multiple paragraphs are overly long and an abbreviation is undefined.

findings.title: Proposal exceeds maximum allowed length
findings.description: The total text length of the proposal (excluding figures, tables, and schedule) spans more than 6 pages, violating the 4‑6 page limit.

findings.title: Objective subsections lack required detail and insufficient paragraph count
findings.description: Each objective subsection contains only a single paragraph; the guidelines require at least two paragraphs with detailed descriptions for every objective.

locations.section: 4.1 Unify Heterogeneous Resources in One Tree
locations.quote: I model the resources as a tree whose folders pass maintainership, audit policy, and grants down to leaves bound to target systems, as the UML object diagram in Figure 2 shows.

locations.section: 4.2 Enforce an Expiry Date on Every Grant
locations.quote: The platform changes Keycloak only with the token of the calling user and holds no service account, so no background process of the platform can remove a membership.

locations.section: 4.3 Delegate the Approval of Requests to Maintainers
locations.quote: Requesters fll in a declarative request form instead of naming resources, and its rules turn answers into requests for a resource path, an access level, and a duration, which the platform routes to the maintainer of each resource.

locations.section: 4.4 Automate the Recertifcation of Active Grants
locations.quote: Every resource carries a recertifcation interval that its descendants inherit, and each elapsed interval opens a campaign in which the maintainer keeps or revokes every grant with an immutable decision.

findings.title: Paragraphs exceed recommended length
findings.description: Several paragraphs (abstract, introductory sections, problem, motivation, and objective) span more than ten lines, exceeding the 5‑8 line recommendation.
